import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { buildEventProjection } from "/home/sawyer/.bb/plugins/environment-git-worktree/host-data/worktrees/thr_eqqr6um2j4-1/bb-150k/packages/thread-view/src/build-event-projection.ts";
const out = process.argv[2];
const T = "thr_fixture000";
function build(name: string, raw: any[]) {
  let seq = 0;
  const compacted = raw.map((e) => {
    seq += 1;
    const event = { threadId: T, scope: { kind: "turn", turnId: "t1" }, ...e };
    return { event, meta: { id: `ev${seq}`, seq, createdAt: 1000 + seq * 10 } };
  });
  const base = { completedTurnDisplay: "collapse", includeDiagnosticOperations: false, includeNestedRows: false, isLatestPage: true, threadName: "Fixture thread", workspaceRoot: "/tmp/ws" };
  const results = ["idle", "active"].map((threadStatus) => {
    const options = { ...base, threadStatus };
    return { options, projection: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(buildEventProjection(compacted as any, options as any))) };
  });
  writeFileSync(`${out}/${name}.json`, JSON.stringify({ compacted, results }, null, 1));
}
const started = { type: "turn/started" };
const cmd = (type: string, id: string, extra: any = {}) => ({ type, item: { type: "commandExecution", id, command: "ls", cwd: "/w", status: "pending", approvalStatus: null, ...extra } });
const delta = (id: string, delta: string, extra: any = {}) => ({ type: "item/commandExecution/outputDelta", itemId: id, delta, ...extra });
build("tool-activity-explore", [
  started,
  { type: "item/started", item: { type: "fileRead", id: "r1", path: "/w/a.ts", status: "inProgress" } },
  { type: "item/completed", item: { type: "fileRead", id: "r1", path: "/w/a.ts", status: "completed" } },
  { type: "item/started", item: { type: "search", id: "s1", mode: "content", query: "foo", status: "inProgress" } },
  { type: "item/started", item: { type: "fileRead", id: "r2", path: "/w/b.ts", status: "inProgress" } },
  { type: "item/completed", item: { type: "search", id: "s1", mode: "content", query: "foo bar", status: "completed" } },
  { type: "item/started", item: { type: "planSteps", id: "p1", steps: [{ step: "one", status: "pending" }], status: "inProgress" } },
  { type: "item/completed", item: { type: "planSteps", id: "p1", steps: [{ step: "one", status: "completed" }, { step: "two", status: "pending" }], explanation: "x", status: "completed" } },
  cmd("item/started", "c1", { command: "cat a.ts" }),
  cmd("item/completed", "c1", { command: "cat a.ts", status: "completed", exitCode: 0, aggregatedOutput: "aaa\n" }),
  { type: "turn/completed", status: "completed" },
]);
